title: Numbers With Repeated Digits
summary: For a given integer n, count how many positive integers within the range from 1 to n have at least one digit that repeats.
statement: For a given integer n, count how many positive integers within the range from 1 to n have at least one digit that repeats.
constraints: 1<=n and n may have up to ten decimal digits.
Count positive values at most n containing any repeated digit.
reference_solution:
def count_repeated_digit_numbers(n):
 digits=list(map(int,str(n+1)));unique=0
 for length in range(1,len(digits)):
  ways=9
  for used_count in range(1,length):ways*=10-used_count
  unique+=ways
 used=set()
 for i,digit in enumerate(digits):
  for choice in range(0 if i else 1,digit):
   if choice not in used:
    ways=1
    for remaining in range(len(digits)-i-1):ways*=10-len(used)-1-remaining
    unique+=ways
  if digit in used:break
  used.add(digit)
 else:return n-unique
 return n-unique
